# Edit Salary

Payroll provides comprehensive tools for editing employee salary components during payroll processing. The Edit Salary interface allows HR teams to make adjustments for additions, deductions, arrears and loss of pay days while maintaining accurate records for compliance.

    
### Features

            
            Feature | Description | Example
            ---
            **Salary Additions** | Add one-time components to employee salary for the current payroll cycle. | Previously, adding bonuses required manual calculations. Now, the system allows direct addition of components with automatic tax calculations.
            ---
            **Deductions Management** | Apply one-time or recurring deductions during payroll processing. | Manual deduction tracking led to errors. Now, all deductions are systematically applied with clear documentation.
            ---
            **Arrears Processing** | Calculate and add salary arrears for previous periods with component-wise breakdown. | Arrear calculations were complex and error-prone. Now, the system automatically computes arrears based on days and components.
            ---
            **RLOP Management** | Process Restricted Leave of Pay with accurate salary deductions. | Loss of pay calculations were inconsistent. Now, RLOP days are systematically deducted with proportional component adjustments.
            

        

## Edit Salary Interface

The Edit Salary interface provides tools for modifying employee salary components during payroll processing. Access this feature when running payroll to make necessary adjustments.

### Accessing Edit Salary

To edit an employee's salary:
1. Navigate to payroll processing.
2. Select the employee.
3. Click **Edit Salary** to open the modification interface.

The interface displays tabs for:
- Addition
- Deduction
- Arrears
- RLOP

    
        Use the Addition tab to add one-time components to an employee's salary for the current payroll cycle.

        For step-by-step guidance and component details, see [Additions and Deductions in Run Payroll](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/payroll/run-payroll.md#additions-and-deductions).
    

    
        Use the Deduction tab to apply one-time or recurring deductions for the current payroll period.

        For steps and examples, see [Additions and Deductions in Run Payroll](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/payroll/run-payroll.md#additions-and-deductions).
    

    
        Use the Arrears tab to add or edit component-wise arrears for previous periods.

        For full steps and examples, see [Pay Employee Level Arrears in Run Payroll](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/payroll/run-payroll.md#pay-employee-level-arrears).
    

    
        Use the RLOP tab to reverse loss of pay deductions and add RLOP arrears.

        For steps and eligibility, see [Reverse Loss of Pay (RLOP)](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/payroll/run-payroll/rlop.md).
